alias-of:ivvah_605>avva_123@0bb66c.note: Ava (17:24) and Ivah (18:34) appear in near-identical lists of cities. That they are one place is a spelling reading, not stated.

alias-of:rumah_1014>arumah_98@958ce4.note: Rumah (23:36) and Arumah (Judg 9:41) differ by one letter. That they are one town is a reading from outside the text.

alias-of:topheth_1176>valley_of_hinnom_1.note: The text says Topheth is in the valley of the children of Hinnom, so it is part of the valley, not the same place.

alias-of:valley_of_the_son_of_hinnom_122.note: Josh 15:8 names the valley both 'of the son of Hinnom' and 'of Hinnom'; 23:10 has 'children of Hinnom'. Spelling reading.

alias-of:zion_1263>mount_zion_860@2d4040.note: 'Daughter of Zion' (19:21) and 'mount Zion' (19:31) name the city's hill in parallel phrasing. Identity is a reading.

alias-of:zions_1264>mount_zion_860@05009.note: Possessive 'Zion's' key. The text has 'daughter of Zion' (19:21) and 'mount Zion' (19:31); same hill is a reading.

birth:jehoiachin_791@978c50.note: Eighteen years old at accession (24:8). The year -615 depends on dating outside Scripture.

birth:jehoiakim_1085@e6f6de.note: Twenty-five years old at accession (23:36). The year -633 depends on dating outside Scripture.

birth:manasseh_1930@284bb6.note: Twelve years old at accession (21:1). The year -708 depends on dating outside Scripture.

birth:zedekiah_1950@79314f.note: Twenty-one years old at accession (24:18). The year -617 depends on dating outside Scripture.

date:death-of-amon@0e9679.note: Two-year reign (21:19), then slain in his house (21:23). The year -639 depends on dating outside Scripture.

date:death-of-hezekiah@14f85c.note: Twenty-nine-year reign (18:2), then slept with his fathers (20:21). The year -696 depends on dating outside Scripture.

date:death-of-josiah@2ba304.note: Thirty-one-year reign (22:1), then slain at Megiddo (23:29). The year -608 depends on dating outside Scripture.

date:death-of-manasseh@c4bba4.note: Fifty-five-year reign (21:1), then slept with his fathers (21:18). The year -641 depends on dating outside Scripture.

date:reign-of-amon@8ee44d.note: Two-year reign (21:19). The years -641 to -639 depend on dating outside Scripture.

date:reign-of-hezekiah@e94ed3.note: Twenty-nine-year reign (18:2) from Hoshea's third year (18:1). The years -725 to -696 depend on outside dating.

date:reign-of-jeconiah@832552.note: Three-month reign in Nebuchadnezzar's eighth year (24:8, 24:12). The year -597 depends on dating outside Scripture.

date:reign-of-jehoiakim@5f8b46.note: Eleven-year reign (23:36), three years as Nebuchadnezzar's servant (24:1). The years -608 to -597 depend on outside dating.

date:reign-of-johoahaz-shallum@2ba304.note: Three-month reign (23:31). The year -608 depends on dating outside Scripture.

date:reign-of-josiah@baafe7.note: Thirty-one-year reign (22:1). The years -639 to -608 depend on dating outside Scripture.

date:reign-of-manasseh@700bfc.note: Fifty-five-year reign (21:1). The years -696 to -641 depend on dating outside Scripture.

date:reign-of-zedekiah@fb5f36.note: Eleven-year reign (24:18), besieged to the eleventh year (25:2). The years -596 to -585 depend on outside dating.

death:amon_236@0e9679.note: Two-year reign (21:19), slain in his house (21:23). The year -639 depends on dating outside Scripture.

death:jehoiakim_1085@832552.note: Eleven-year reign ends and his son reigns (24:6). The year -597 depends on dating outside Scripture.

death:manasseh_1930@c4bba4.note: Fifty-five-year reign ends; he slept with his fathers (21:18). The year -641 depends on dating outside Scripture.

died-at:ahaziah_121>jerusalem_636@a9cf66.note: Ahaziah of Judah fled to Megiddo and died there (9:27). His servants buried him in Jerusalem (9:28).

died-at:amon_236>jerusalem_636@0a47c5.note: He reigned in Jerusalem (21:19) and was slain in his own house (21:23). That house is in Jerusalem is a reading.

died-at:jehoiachin_791>babylon_151@9d727.note: Released from prison in Babylon and fed there all his life (25:27-30). No place of death is given.

died-at:josiah_1730>jerusalem_636@70207e.note: He was slain at Megiddo (23:29); his servants carried his body to Jerusalem to bury him (23:30).

died-at:zedekiah_1950>babylon_151@2592e1.note: Carried to Babylon and kept in prison there until the day of his death (Jer 52:11).

house:kingdom-of-judah/reign-of-johoahaz.note: Josiah's son who was made king (23:30); the text says Josiah walked in David's way (22:2). 'House of David' is an outside label.

house:kingdom-of-judah/reign-of-zedekiah.note: Made king in place of Jehoiachin (24:17), a brother of Jehoiakim. The text links Judah's kings to David (22:2); 'House of David' is outside.

member-of:abijah_14>genealogy-of-jesus@d.note: 18:2 names this Abi, Hezekiah's mother. Matt 1:7 Abia is a son of Roboam, a different person.

member-of:amon_236>tribe-of-judah@069a54.note: Descent from Judas through David and Manasses (Matt 1:2-10). The tribe label is an outside reading.

member-of:hilkiah_1524>tribe-of-levi@ac3.note: Called the high priest (22:4). Levi descent is outside this passage.

member-of:jehoahaz_2516>tribe-of-judah@b.note: Son of Josiah in Judah's line (Matt 1:2-10). 1 Chr 3:15 lists Shallum among Josiah's sons; Shallum = Jehoahaz is a reading.

member-of:jehoiachin_791>tribe-of-judah@.note: Son of Josiah in Judah's line (Matt 1:2-11). Jechonias = Jehoiachin, and 1 Chr 3:16 'Jeconiah', is a reading.

member-of:jehoiakim_1085>tribe-of-judah@.note: Son of Josiah (23:34), and Josiah is in Judah's line (Matt 1:2-10). The tribe label is an outside reading.

member-of:manasseh_1930>tribe-of-judah@e.note: Son of Hezekiah in Judah's line (Matt 1:2-10; 1 Chr 3:13). The tribe label is an outside reading.

member-of:seraiah_2494>tribe-of-levi@bd2.note: Called the chief priest (25:18). Levi descent is outside this passage.

member-of:zedekiah_1950>tribe-of-judah@5.note: Son of Josiah (1 Chr 3:15; 2 Kgs 24:17 'his father's brother'), in Judah's line (Matt 1:2-10). The tribe label is an outside reading.

occurred-at:death-of-amon>uzza_1192@c3fa.note: He was slain in his own house (21:23). Uzza is where he was buried (21:26), not where he died.

occurred-at:death-of-manasseh>uzza_1192@.note: 21:18 gives his burial place, the garden of Uzza. It does not say where he died.

parent-of:hasrah_1414>tikvah_2855@bd95af.note: 22:14 says Tikvah is the son of Harhas; 2 Chr 34:22 spells it Hasrah. That the two spellings name one man is a reading.

parent-of:hephzi-bah_1499>manasseh_1930@.note: 21:1 names his mother Hephzibah, the same name spelled without the hyphen.

parent-of:kareah_919>johanan_1666@bd9bbb.note: 25:23 names Johanan the son of Careah. The key spells it Kareah; same name, different spelling.

parent-of:sennacherib_2489>adrammelech_1.note: Adrammelech and Sharezer are named as Sennacherib's sons who killed him.

parent-of:sennacherib_2489>esar-haddon_1.note: Esarhaddon, his son, reigned in his stead after Sennacherib's death.

parent-of:sennacherib_2489>sharezer_2559.note: Adrammelech and Sharezer are named as Sennacherib's sons who killed him.

part-of:mount_zion_860>jerusalem_636@651.note: 19:31 names Jerusalem and mount Zion as the remnant's sources in parallel. That the hill lies within the city is a reading.

part-of:uzza_1192>jerusalem_636@73c4d5.note: Manasseh and Amon were buried in the garden of Uzza, by their own house (21:18, 21:26). Uzza's place relative to Jerusalem is not stated.

participated-in:pharaoh-nechoh_2337>deat.note: 'He slew him at Megiddo' follows Pharaoh going up against Assyria and Josiah going against him. The pronoun is not named, but Pharaoh is the likely slayer.

partner-of:abijah_14>ahaz_118@713d78.note: 18:2 names Abi as Hezekiah's mother, and Hezekiah is Ahaz's son (18:1). The marriage is inferred, not stated.

partner-of:amon_236>jedidah_761@200819.note: Jedidah is Josiah's mother (22:1), and Josiah is Amon's son (21:26). The marriage is inferred, not stated.

partner-of:hamutal_1368>josiah_1730@e30e.note: Hamutal is Jehoahaz's mother (23:31), and Jehoahaz is Josiah's son (23:30). The marriage is inferred, not stated.

partner-of:hephzi-bah_1499>hezekiah_1512.note: Hephzibah is Manasseh's mother (21:1), and Manasseh is Hezekiah's son (20:21). The marriage is inferred, not stated.

partner-of:huldah_1567>shallum_2515@d504.note: Huldah the prophetess is named as the wife of Shallum the son of Tikvah.

partner-of:jehoiakim_1085>nehushta_2174@.note: Nehushta is Jehoiachin's mother (24:8), and Jehoiachin is Jehoiakim's son (24:6). The marriage is inferred, not stated.

partner-of:josiah_1730>zebudah_3000@e22c.note: Zebudah is Jehoiakim's mother (23:36), and Jehoiakim is Josiah's son (23:34). The marriage is inferred, not stated.

partner-of:manasseh_1930>meshullemeth_20.note: Meshullemeth is Amon's mother (21:19), and Amon is Manasseh's son (21:18). The marriage is inferred, not stated.
